stops.name: Staubbach Falls
stops.quote: Experience one of the highest free-falling waterfalls in Europe: The Staubbach Falls in Lauterbrunnen plunge 297 meters into the depths.
stops.english: Experience one of the highest free-falling waterfalls in Europe: The Staubbach Falls in Lauterbrunnen plunge 297 meters into the depths.

stops.quote: Popular holiday park at the foot of the mountains Jungfrau, Mönch and Eiger, Schilthorn and the Staubbach waterfall.

stops.name: Lütschine River
stops.quote: You'll ride with motor assistance along the Lütschine River to the Staubbach Falls and Trümmelbach Falls.
stops.english: You'll ride with motor assistance along the Lütschine River to the Staubbach Falls and Trümmelbach Falls.

stops.name: Lauterbrunnen Valley
stops.quote: A total of 72 waterfalls gush down into the Lauterbrunnen Valley from the vertical cliff faces, some of which are as high as 400m.
stops.english: A total of 72 waterfalls gush down into the Lauterbrunnen Valley from the vertical cliff faces, some of which are as high as 400m.

stops.name: Stechelberg
stops.quote: The roar and rush of these unique natural spectacles accompanies hikers on this picturesque trail from Lauterbrunnen to Stechelberg.
stops.english: The roar and rush of these unique natural spectacles accompanies hikers on this picturesque trail from Lauterbrunnen to Stechelberg.

stops.name: Wengen
stops.quote: Wengen – enjoy the idyllic and sun-drenched mountain village at the foot of the Jungfrau and marvel at the spectacular views over the Lauterbrunnen Valley.
stops.english: Wengen – enjoy the idyllic and sun-drenched mountain village at the foot of the Jungfrau and marvel at the spectacular views over the Lauterbrunnen Valley.

stops.name: Mürren
stops.quote: Discover the mountain village of Mürren high above the Lauterbrunnen Valley.
stops.english: Discover the mountain village of Mürren high above the Lauterbrunnen Valley.
